# PLG Strategy by 15 September

All pillars feed into one goal: a readable PLG signal by 15 September — measurement, real signups, and a live feedback loop.

## Velocity Rules

- No new features without a metric to validate them.
- Friday = retrospective + planning only.

docs.title: P1 Positioning & Messaging Doc
docs.content:
# P1 Positioning & Messaging

## Current Positioning Statement
Radium is the AI-native platform that lets teams deploy, scale, and monitor autonomous AI agents in production — without the infrastructure complexity.

## Messaging Hierarchy

### One-liner
"Deploy AI agents. Scale them. Sleep at night."

### Tagline
"The command center for AI-driven teams."

### Value Propositions
1. **Zero-infrastructure deployment** — Push agents to prod in minutes, not weeks.
2. **Fleet-wide observability** — See what every agent is doing, in real time.
3. **Human-in-the-loop when it matters** — Escalate edge cases without losing autonomy.

## Target Personas
- **Primary**: Engineering leads at Series A-C SaaS companies building AI features.
- **Secondary**: CTOs evaluating AI infrastructure platforms.
- **Tertiary**: AI product managers who need visibility into agent behavior.

## Competitive Positioning
| Dimension | Radium | LangChain | AutoGPT |
|-----------|--------|-----------|---------|
| Production focus | ✅ First-class | ⚠️ Framework | ❌ Experimental |
| Observability | ✅ Built-in | ❌ None | ❌ None |
| Human override | ✅ Native | ❌ None | ❌ None |

## Messaging Test Results (August 2026)
- Homepage A/B: "AI agents, deployed" won +12% CTR over "Production Agent Platform."
- "Zero infrastructure" performed +18% better than "Production-ready AI" in LinkedIn ads.

## Decision Log
- 15 Aug: Solidified "fleet" metaphor — agents as a fleet moving in formation.
- 22 Aug: Dropped "orchestration" language — too enterprise-y.
- 29 Aug: Moved from "autonomous agents" to "AI agents" — simpler, broader appeal.

# P4 Conversion Playbook

## Current Funnel Metrics
| Step | Rate | Target |
|------|------|--------|
| Homepage → Pricing | 18% | 25% |
| Pricing → Signup start | 35% | 45% |
| Signup start → Complete | 52% | 70% |
| Complete → API key created | — | Track Q3 |

## Known Friction
1. Email verification step drops 30% of users.
2. Pricing page has no comparison table.
3. No social proof on signup page.

## Experiments Queue
1. Remove email verification for non-sensitive features.
2. Add "Trusted by X teams" banner to pricing.
3. Interactive demo on homepage.

## Decision Log
- 5 Aug: Moved from 3-tier to 2-tier pricing (simpler = better).
- 18 Aug: Added Calendly CTA on pricing for enterprise inquiries.

docs.title: P5 Retention & Expansion Framework
docs.content:
# P5 Retention & Expansion Framework

## Retention Signals
| Signal | Health Threshold | Action |
|--------|-----------------|--------|
| Weekly active agents | ≥ 3 per team | ✅ Healthy |
| API calls / week | ≥ 100 | ✅ Healthy |
| Time since last login | > 7 days | 🚨 Re-engagement email |

## Expansion Triggers
1. Team grows to 5+ members → auto-suggest Team plan.
2. API usage > 80% of tier → upgrade nudge.
3. Custom integration request → enterprise outreach.

## Decision Log
- 3 Aug: Defined "product-qualified lead" = 3+ agents deployed + 7+ day streak.
- 20 Aug: Started weekly "Fleet Health" email to active users.

docs.content:
# P6 Measurement & Analytics Setup

## Tools Stack
| Layer | Tool | Status |
|-------|------|--------|
| Web analytics | Contentsquare | 🟡 Tracking set up |
| Product analytics | HubSpot (custom events) | 🟢 Live |
| Ads tracking | Google Ads + GTM | 🟡 Conversion events need wiring |
| Backend monitoring | Custom + Datadog | 🟢 Live |

## Key Events to Track
- `page_view` (homepage, pricing, docs)
- `signup_start`
- `signup_complete`
- `api_key_created` (product-qualified moment)
- `agent_deployed`
- `agent_error` (for health monitoring)

## Decision Log
- 2 Aug: Chose Contentsquare over Hotjar for scroll-depth and session replay.
- 15 Aug: HubSpot product events pipeline built — api_key_created now tracked.
- 28 Aug: Contentsquare firing but dashboards incomplete.
